meaning: The galaxies of Cosmicflows-4 and 2MRS out to 200 Mpc, even across the field: Each dot is one galaxy at its measured distance, in the color of its morphological type.

densityCap.basis: Presentation choice: 0.18 per 1,000 Mpc³, half the 0.37 CF4 still holds between 150 and 200 Mpc, so the field is even out to its edge; the taper softens the edge where the catalogue ends. It is counted in shells 10 Mpc wide around the Sun, so only the catalogue's fall-off with distance is evened and a cluster keeps its contrast with the space around it. Each shell's room is split evenly over 32 equal-area cells of the sky (skyBands 4), so the northern sky SDSS covers densely does not take the room of the southern sky and the low latitudes 2MRS fills.

groupsFirst.basis: Presentation choice: a shell's room goes first to galaxies in Cosmicflows-4 groups of two or more, the richest group first, so the dots trace the groups, filaments and clusters; as many again, drawn at random from the rest, fill the space between them, so the view still reads as open space. Doubling the dots cost no measurable time in the zoom profile (2026-09-30). Every member of a group of five or more is kept here, the outermost level, room or not: the inner levels only fill in around the Milky Way, so without this a cluster far from it, such as Virgo, would show only part of its members from anywhere else.
